description: Window [1→5]: idea-pmf through design-ux. Asserts 5 stages in order, UX HARD disciplines present, stop at design-ux with no architecture phase marker (no over-run).

turns.text: Activate cycle:idea-to-design. I want to go from idea to a validated UX design ready for the next stage. Start at idea-pmf.
Continue: strategy-positioning — define positioning and product strategy.
Continue: analysis-discovery — technical discovery and current-state comparison.
Continue: specification — spec with schema contracts.
Continue: design-ux — UX flows, component specs, usability evidence. This is the window stop. Do NOT proceed past the window stop.
